gloss: wad of bills; bundle of banknotes

definitions.gloss: wad of bills; bundle of banknotes
definitions.explanation: A stack or bundle of paper currency. Often evokes an image of large amounts of cash.

examples.japanese: {札束|さつたば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}えている→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧。
examples.english: He is counting a wad of bills.

examples.japanese: ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{札束|さつたば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{積|つ}まれていた→積む：02294_tsumu⟧。
examples.english: Bundles of banknotes were stacked on the desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦スーツケース→スーツケース：01781_suutsukeesu⟧いっぱい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{札束|さつたば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: In the movie, the criminal ran away with a suitcase full of bundles of cash.

notes:
USAGE:
{札束|さつたば} literally combines ⟦{札|さつ}→札：02153_satsu⟧ (banknote) and ⟦{束|たば}→束：03406_taba⟧ (bundle). It conjures images of wealth or large cash transactions and frequently appears in crime dramas and news stories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {札束|さつたば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧ (to count a wad of bills)
- {札束|さつたば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧ (to stack bundles of bills)
- {札束|さつたば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たたく (to wave money around to get what you want — lit. "to slap someone's cheek with a wad of cash")

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧ means cash in general, while {札束|さつたば} specifically refers to a visible stack or bundle of paper money.
